properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js@1.1.7, top-level lockfile:11940 — pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-256/RIPEMD-160 (and more), runtime dep of elliptic@6.5.3 (ECDSA internal hashing, HMAC-DRBG seeding via lockfile:1974) and of ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3. Ships in the published package's node_modules. Hash primitives — no PQ urgency; the SHA-1 surface is worth listing in the CBOM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1@4.0.2 native addon (lockfile:17533, no dev flag) plus elliptic's curve preset: the Ethereum signature curve. Runtime dep via ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (lockfile:2216) and ethereumjs-util@6.2.1, both reachable from the published ganache-cli package; further copies in ganache-core's tree are compiled into the webpack bundle. Every simulated account key and every transaction signature in this Ethereum simulator is ECDSA over secp256k1 — the tool is a secp256k1 signer by definition. Quan

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: evp_bytestokey@1.0.3 (top-level lockfile:2261, runtime via browserify-aes@1.2.0 ← ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3) implements OpenSSL's legacy EVP_BytesToKey: a single-round MD5 KDF (md5.js dep) deriving AES key+IV from a password. Ships in the published package tree and the bundle. Weak by construction — one MD5 pass, no salt unless the caller salts — and reachable whenever browserify-aes is driven in password mode.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: create-ecdh@4.0.4, crypto-browserify's ECDH shim over elliptic (lockfile:1656 top entry, 1711/4864/4921 inside crypto-browserify 3.12.0, all dev-flagged, one nested copy dev+optional). Dev-only in the lockfile, but present in the Docker build environment and compiled into the published bundle wherever ganache-core's require graph reaches crypto-browserify (web3's eth-lib requires it). No ECDH call site in this repo's first-party code — the CLI itself never does key agreement. Classical key agree

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.3 at top-level lockfile:1967 with no dev flag — runtime, required by ethereumjs-util@6.2.1 (a production dependency of the published package), by the secp256k1@4.0.2 native addon and by create-ecdh. Pure-JS ECDSA sign/verify plus ECDH over secp256k1 and other presets, with keys/nonces from hmac-drbg seeded by brorand. 6.5.3 predates the 6.5.4/6.6.x invalid-curve and signature-malleability fixes. Quantum-unsafe (Shor). This and LIB-a0bfbc1a are the same package recorded at two levels

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 (nested lockfile:10519 inside ganache-core's tree; older 0.14.5 copies also ship under sshpk, which serves request's http-signature for the fork feature). NaCl crypto_box/scalarMult X25519 is available in the shipped bundle; no call site in this repo's first-party code — consumers live in ganache-core/web3. Available-in-library; classical key agreement, Shor-vulnerable, ML-KEM-768 is the eventual replacement.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: keccak@3.0.1 native addon (lockfile:12392) and js-sha3, runtime deps via ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3/ethereumjs-util@6.2.1. Keccak-256 is Ethereum's hash: transaction hashes, EIP-55 address checksums (called live at cli.js:172), the EVM KECCAK256 opcode, and the state/Merkle-Patricia trie (merkle-patricia-tree@3.0.0 in ganache-core's tree). Hash primitive — Grover gives only square-root speedup; no PQ migration pressure, and the algorithm is fixed by the Ethereum protocol regardless.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1, top-level lockfile:17528 with no dev flag — runtime via ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (lockfile:2227) and web3-eth-accounts@1.2.11 keystore handling (lockfile:10966); dev copies at 6244/9593 are the same package in ganache-core's tree that gets webpack-bundled. This is the Web3 Secret Storage v3 KDF that protects keystore files. N/r/p parameters are chosen by callers inside ganache-core (not visible in this repo). Password KDF — Grover-halving only; weak-parameter risk is classica

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3's secretbox (XSalsa20 stream cipher + Poly1305 MAC) available in the shipped bundle. Symmetric AE — quantum impact is Grover halving only, so the A+ rating is right; the operative risk is that tweetnacl's 1.0.x line is effectively unmaintained. No call site in first-party code; consumers (if any) live in ganache-core's dependency graph.

properties.value: pbkdf2@3.1.1, the crypto-browserify PBKDF2 shim — runtime via ethereum-cryptography@0.1.3 (lockfile:2225 'pbkdf2 ^3.0.17') and bip39@2.5.0 ('pbkdf2 ^3.0.9'); on Node it delegates to crypto.pbkdf2Sync (OpenSSL HMAC).
